notes.title: Wargames Festival Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Demo Updates

Bosses now drop Power Shards when defeated.
Controls updated for Commander, with more feedback and aim assist when placing troops.
Menus improved to be easier to navigate.
Balance improvements for Grenade Mech and Heavy Tank.
Health bars adjusted to be easier to read.
Permanent upgrades buffed in campaign mode.


Improvements

Environment art updated in campaign mode, tutorial, and launch map.
Memory leaks fixed.
Rendering optimizations added.
Game file size greatly reduced.
Procedural generation tweaked to prevent early game difficulty spike.
Lots of bugs and crashes fixed.

notes.title: First Update of 2025!
notes.notes:
Visual Improvements

 A cool 3D Effect has been added to all cards in the Campaign mode!
 All stages now have dynamic moving cloud shadows.
 More explosions, more muzzle flashes, more unique artwork, and more environment interactions!
 Multiple visual bugs fixed!


More Content

 New Equipment added to the shop in campaign mode!
 Blitz Tank boss updated with new abilities and artwork!
 New Permanent Upgrades available in the supply shop!
 New Dialogue added to the campaign mode!
 New Mechanic: Mech Boosting allows mechs to be powered up for a short time after exiting the Command Tank!


Quality of Life Improvements

 Pause menu overhauled to work better with a mouse, and add more options.
 Campaign difficulty updated to provide a better experience.
 Lots of bugs fixed.

notes.title: New Content Update!
notes.notes:
I've made lots of updates to the game recently! Here's a couple of note: 

New Troops
Heavy Support Drone

Can be deployed anywhere on the map, like an ability.
Heals friendlies at 90 HP / second.
The 'Missile Barrage' ability fires 10 micro missiles at nearby enemies.

Rocket Trooper

 Reworked to be an anti-player troop. 
 Hard-targets players, with increased range!


New Bosses
Border Guard Tank

 This behemoth will chase your Command Tank
 Shoot the engine! Don't let it get close with its drill!
 Multiple turret emplacements target both players and the Command Tank.
 New and varied turrets pop out in later boss phases.


Campaign Meta-Progression

 Permanent currencies can now be used to research and build new permanent upgrades called supplies!
 The deep customization of the Tech and Equipment systems has been expanded upon with even more unique items!
